title: AI Engineer - Technical Enablement - remote/Tel-Aviv
description_html: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for  all .    Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.     Key Responsibilities     AI solution development:  Build and deploy AI tools and workflows using platforms such as Copilot Studio, UiPath, and other automation frameworks.   Integration & enablement : Connect AI agents with enterprise systems (e.g., SharePoint, M365), external APIs, and knowledge bases for seamless interoperability.   Process automation : Identify repetitive tasks and design intelligent automation to improve efficiency.   Security & identity integration : Secure agent interactions via encryption, authentication, and authorization; integrate with identity platforms (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, Entra ID, AD FS) for access control.   Governance & compliance : Partner with cybersecurity on data protection and threat modeling, ensuring solutions meet security, ethical, and compliance standards.   Collaboration & training : Enable AI literacy across teams through best-practice documentation and internal training.   Continuous improvement : Collect feedback, iterate, and contribute to a culture of innovation and scale.      Required Qualifications     Education:  Bachelor's or master's in computer science, AI, machine learning, data science, or a related field, or equivalent related experience.   Experience:  5+ years in software development, including 2+ years in AI/ML engineering.   AI & automation foundations : Strong grasp of AI concepts, ML pipelines, and automation tools; hands-on with Copilot Studio, UiPath, and SharePoint.   Agentic & context engineering : Multi-agent workflows for complex tasks; context management via RAG, semantic chunking, and memory persistence; MCP-based context-aware systems including prompt engineering and context-window optimization; agent orchestration and A2A (agent-to-agent) systems.   Cloud & integration : Cloud AI platforms (Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, and/or Google Vertex AI), API integrations, and data-quality validation.   Development languages : .NET, C#, Python, Java, API development, SQL, PowerShell, Unix shell scripting.   Ways of working : Strong problem-solving, fast-paced agile delivery, and cross-team communication.      Preferred Qualifications     Generative AI & agents : Exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or agent-based systems.   Governance & responsible AI:  Interest in AI governance, security, and ethical frameworks.    Delivery mindset : Adapts quickly and delivers quick wins while maintaining enterprise standards.    About Micron Technology, Inc.   We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life  for all . With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® brand. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience. title: Full Stack Engineer, Support Experience (Greater China Support)
Frontend Web Software Engineer, NGC
description_html: You will join the team responsible for building the foundational user experience for NVIDIA GPU Cloud (NGC), the unified platform for all NVIDIA cloud-based products. This is a core role passionate about delivering the next generation of essential, high-impact services that underpin the entire NGC ecosystem. This engineer works alongside architects, designers, and backend engineers to deliver a world-class, secure, and modern interface for our enterprise customers. We seek a collaborator with an open and encouraging approach who is eager to deliver quality software systems in a rapidly evolving cloud environment. The Frontend Web Software Engineer will mainly work on web applications built with React.js, applying modern component-based architectures and focusing on well-tested, standards-compliant code. The successful candidate will have a growth mindset and proactively apply AI tools and agents to improve development effectiveness and increase efficiency throughout the product lifecycle.     What you will be doing:     Build and implement critical features for core NGC services, including Identity and Access Management, user and group management, account security and credentials, and billing and subscription flows.    Play a key role in developing the unified portal that acts as the gateway for all NVIDIA cloud products.    Proactively apply AI tools and agents to boost code quality, speed up development, and increase overall system stability.    Drive the evolution of our application architecture and development patterns for increasingly large and complex components.    Work closely with Product, UX, and Backend teams to convert complex requirements into elegant, responsive UIs and satisfying user experiences.    Participate in all stages of the product lifecycle, including planning, documentation, code review, and offering helpful insights.    Estimate personal timelines and coordinate work to deliver achievements effectively.    Present and/or demonstrate your work/research in front of colleagues from across the company.       What we need to see:     At least 5 years of relevant experience    Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Web Development, or a related field (or equivalent experience)    Experience working as a contributor to a medium-to-large scale frontend web application or project    Experience working with React.js or another comparable framework (Vue.js, SvelteKit, Angular)    Skill in developing refined, responsive user interfaces that ensure a pleasing user experience    Engage with technical requirements, understand complex systems, and efficiently come up with coded solutions    Ability to build meaningful tests using established patterns    Open attitude about sharing work-in-progress and developing ideas (from yourself and others)    Enthusiasm for the fundamentals of frontend work: JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and the ecosystem that surrounds the client-side application       Ways to stand out from the crowd:     Direct experience with leading software development at a project / component level, large complex web-based software projects, and building applications with a mainstream JavaScript framework (React, Vue, Angular, Svelte)    Experience with Typescript, bundle configuration with Webpack, and testing frameworks like Cypress, Selenium, Jest, etc.    Has built software with Python, Go, Java, or similar programming language    Has delivered software in a cloud context and is familiar with the patterns and process of managing cloud infrastructure    Demonstrated interest in Kubernetes, cloud-native computing, and frontend development: JavaScript modules, accessibility, styles and layout, etc.      Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family  www.nvidiabenefits.com/       Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 152,000 USD - 241,500 USD.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 8, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.   NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.
